positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
description: Architected a layered recommendation system separating frontend UI components from a Python service-layer engine, evaluating 15 ergonomic attributes across 100+ chairs through structured seat-range and user preference models.

Designed a three-phase pipeline consisting of hard constraint filtering, weighted scoring, and ranked classification with explanation generation, incorporating deterministic tie-breaking, confidence scores, and structured missing-data handling.

Working within an Agile team, reduced recurring validation defects by 30% across a multi-module B4A/B4X application by implementing 40+ targeted unit and regression tests covering boundary conditions and invalid inputs.
